wheelStates.verse: asato mā sad gamaya / tamaso mā jyotir gamaya / mṛtyor mā amṛtaṃ gamaya
discoveries: gamaya = 2sg imperative of causative gamayati from √gam
sat + gamaya → sad gamaya: final t voices before g
asataḥ + mā → asato mā; tamasaḥ + mā → tamaso mā
